title: Samsung’s working on new international SIM tools for One UI 9.5
summary: One UI 9.5 code shows travel SIM usage tracking by trip and day.
body: TL;DR Samsung appears to be building new SIM tracking and reporting tools for One UI 9.5. The system would differentiate between home SIMs and those intended primarily for international travel. Users will be able to track daily usage, as well as access historical reports. Working with multiple SIMs can provide a lot of flexibility in terms of how you access data when traveling, and with its upcoming One UI 9.5 release, Samsung looks like it’s getting ready to introduce some helpful new tools for tracking usage and managing SIMs. APK teardown: This reporting is based on work-in-progress code. These features may not ship. While dual-SIM phones have been around for ages, it’s the recent rise of eSIM support that has really empowered travelers to easily swap providers at a moment’s notice. But that convenience can also be a bit of a double-edged sword, and this kind of access can also make it easy to overwhelm yourself with more SIM options on your device than you can keep track of.
